text_en: A soft answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
text_cn: 温和的回答，平息忿怒；激昂的言语，使人动怒。

text_en: The tongue of the wise dispenses knowledge, but the mouths of fools pour out folly.
text_cn: 智慧者的舌，广传智慧；愚昧人的口，吐露愚昧。

text_en: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
text_cn: 上主的眼目，处处都在；善人和恶人，他都监视。

text_en: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but perverseness in it breaks the spirit.
text_cn: 抚慰的言辞，有如生命树；刻薄的言语，能刺伤人心。

text_en: A fool despises a parent’s instruction, but the one who heeds admonition is prudent.
text_cn: 愚蠢的人，轻视父亲的管教；遵守规劝的，为人必精明。

text_en: In the house of the righteous there is much treasure, but trouble befalls the income of the wicked.
text_cn: 在义人家里，财产丰富；恶人的收入，必遭毁灭。

text_en: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so the minds of fools.
text_cn: 智慧人的唇，散播智识；愚昧人的心，实不可靠。

text_en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord , but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
text_cn: 上主厌恶恶人的祭献，却喜悦正直人的祈祷。

text_en: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord , but he loves the one who pursues righteousness.
text_cn: 上主厌恶恶人的道路，却喜爱追求正义的人。

text_en: There is severe discipline for one who forsakes the way, but one who hates a rebuke will die.
text_cn: 离弃正道的，必遭严罚；憎恨规劝的，只有死亡。

text_en: Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the Lord , how much more human hearts!
text_cn: 阴府和冥域，都明摆在上主面前，何况世人的心怀！

text_en: Scoffers do not like to be rebuked; they will not go to the wise.
text_cn: 轻狂者不爱受人指责，也不愿与智慧人往来。

text_en: A glad heart makes a cheerful countenance, but by sorrow of heart the spirit is broken.
text_cn: 心中愉快，使面容焕发，心中悲伤，精神即颓丧。

text_en: The mind of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
text_cn: 明达人的心，寻求智识；愚昧人的口，饱食昏愚。

text_en: All the days of the poor are hard, but a cheerful heart has a continual feast.
text_cn: 心情忧伤的，日日困坐愁城；心胸畅快的，时时如享喜宴。

text_en: Better is a little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure and trouble with it.
text_cn: 少有财宝而敬畏上主，胜于富有财宝而诸多烦恼。

text_en: Better is a dinner of vegetables where love is than a fatted ox and hatred with it.
text_cn: 有情吃蔬菜，胜于无情食肥牛。

text_en: Those who are hot-tempered stir up strife, but those who are slow to anger calm contention.
text_cn: 易怒的人，常引起争端；含忍的人，却平息争论。

text_en: The way of the lazy is overgrown with thorns, but the path of the upright is a level highway.
text_cn: 懒惰人的道路，有如荆棘篱笆；正直人的行径，却是康庄大道。

text_en: A wise child makes a glad father, but the foolish despise their mothers.
text_cn: 智慧的儿子，是父亲的喜乐；只有愚昧人，轻视自己的母亲。

text_en: Folly is a joy to one who has no sense, but a person of understanding walks straight ahead.
text_cn: 无知的人，以愚昧为乐；明智的人，却直道而行。

text_en: Without counsel, plans go wrong, but with many advisers they succeed.
text_cn: 缺乏考虑，计划必要失败；谋士众多，策略方克有成。

text_en: To make an apt answer is a joy to anyone, and a word in season, how good it is!
text_cn: 应对得当，自觉快慰；言语适时，何其舒畅！

text_en: For the wise the path of life leads upward, in order to avoid Sheol below.
text_cn: 生命之路使明智人向上，为此他能避免向下的阴府。

text_en: The Lord tears down the house of the proud, but maintains the widow’s boundaries.
text_cn: 上主将拆毁骄傲人的房屋，却要坚定寡妇的地界。

text_en: Evil plans are an abomination to the Lord , but gracious words are pure.
text_cn: 邪恶的阴谋，为上主所憎恶；温良的言语，却为他所喜悦。

text_en: Those who are greedy for unjust gain make trouble for their households, but those who hate bribes will live.
text_cn: 贪求财货的，困扰自己的家庭；憎恶馈赠的，生活必能安定。

text_en: The mind of the righteous ponders how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked pours out evil.
text_cn: 义人的心，只默思善事；恶人的口，只吐露恶语。

text_en: The Lord is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
text_cn: 上主远离恶人，却俯听义人的祈祷。

text_en: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart, and good news refreshes the body.
text_cn: 晶莹的目光，使人心旷神怡；美好的讯息，使人筋骨壮健。

text_en: The ear that heeds wholesome admonition will lodge among the wise.
text_cn: 喜听有益生命劝戒的人，必得列于智慧人的中间。

text_en: Those who ignore instruction despise themselves, but those who heed admonition gain understanding.
text_cn: 避免教导的，是作贱自己；听从规劝的，必获得机智。

text_en: The fear of the Lord is instruction in wisdom, and humility goes before honor.
text_cn: 敬畏上主，是智慧的导师；谦卑自下，是荣耀的先声。
